message: You know that one friend who always seems to panic at the slightest hint of trouble? I used to roll my eyes, but I’ve learned there’s a little wisdom in her frantic energy. The other day, she was fretting over her go-bag, and it got me thinking about how easy it is to overlook the basics. I took a moment to check my own supplies and refresh our family plans. Turns out, a little preparedness can go a long way in keeping the calm! What’s your go-to tip for staying ready without the stress? 😊
